steps.title: Filing of Petition
steps.description: Petition relating to marriage, divorce, maintenance, custody, or other family matters is filed before the Family Court having jurisdiction.

steps.title: Court Scrutiny and Registration
steps.description: Court scrutinizes the petition and registers the case if procedural requirements are satisfied.

steps.title: Issuance of Notice
steps.description: Notice is issued to the respondent to appear and file a reply.

steps.title: Counselling / Mediation
steps.description: Court may direct parties to counselling or mediation to explore settlement, as provided under the Family Courts Act, 1984.

steps.title: Filing of Written Statement
steps.description: Respondent files a written statement responding to the allegations in the petition.

steps.title: Evidence Stage
steps.description: Parties lead oral and documentary evidence in support of their respective claims.

steps.title: Final Arguments
steps.description: Both parties present final submissions before the court.

steps.title: Judgment / Order
steps.description: Court passes judgment or order granting or rejecting the relief sought.

documents_required: Identity and address proof of parties

escalation_paths.condition: Appeal or revision as permitted under applicable family and civil laws
Appeal or Special Leave Petition as permitted by law
